atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: monochrome inventory glyph atlas for a serious post-apocalyptic tabletop game.
Create ONE square 3-by-3 atlas. Nine equal cells in EXACT row-major order, without visible grid, borders or labels. Each active cell contains its ONE requested composition, fully inside that cell, with generous black padding on all sides. Pure solid WHITE silhouettes on perfectly clean BLACK. Flat stencil-like shapes with broad black negative-space cuts; never outline drawings. No gray, colour, gradient, shading, fine engraving, texture, noise, grain, dither or drop shadows. Avoid hairline internal detail: details must remain legible at 16 pixels. Match the restraint, solid coverage and large cutouts of reference image 1. Reference image 1 supplies STYLE ONLY, never its instrument subjects. Reference image 2 supplies the legacy SUBJECTS ONLY: deliberately REMOVE its grid edges, stray pieces, fussy detail and clipping, and use the explicit subject descriptions below instead of tracing its defects. Do not add backgrounds, frames, UI, words, numbers or logos.
CELL 1 (row 1, column 1): ONE complete stout cigar, gently diagonal, with one broad plain band represented by a black gap and one blunt end. No smoke, burning particles, leaf veins, wrapper texture or small lines.
CELL 2 (row 1, column 2): ONE loosely rolled local herbal drug bundle: a short stout rough cigarette with a clearly twisted end and one simple broad wrapper fold. Actual physical object; do NOT add a leaf emblem, fine crinkling, veins, sparks or smoke.
CELL 3 (row 1, column 3): ONE complete sealed square pharmaceutical sachet, slightly tilted, with one broad black inset window and a stout simple top seal. Plain anonymous pre-war packaging; no lettering, zipper teeth, fine parallel seal lines, powder or floating dots.
CELL 4 (row 2, column 1): ONE complete compact synthetic-drug inhaler dispenser with a tall rectangular cartridge and a short projecting mouthpiece at the bottom. ONE large black cartridge window. Strong simple L-shaped physical object; no text, graduations, texture or medicine cross.
CELL 5 (row 2, column 2): A small cluster of exactly THREE chunky irregular synthetic-drug crystal pieces, each with ONE broad black facet cut. A compact sober pile of rough material; not cut gemstones, jewellery, diamonds or tiny fragments.
CELL 6 (row 2, column 3): ONE complete Beretta-92-style service PISTOL in clean side profile, muzzle pointing LEFT: long low open-top slide, rounded trigger guard with a broad empty opening, angled grip and short exposed hammer. At most THREE broad black structural cuts. No bullets, floating specks, weapon diagram, exploded parts, lettering or engraving.
CELL 7 (row 3, column 1): ONE complete small .22-calibre REVOLVER in clean side profile, muzzle pointing LEFT: slim moderate barrel, unmistakable round cylinder, short hammer, a broad empty trigger-guard opening and gently curved grip. At most THREE broad black cuts. No bullets, specks, engraving, fine cylinder grooves, lettering or exploded parts.
CELLS 8, 9 MUST BE COMPLETELY EMPTY BLACK. No filler icons.
Keep the scale and visual weight consistent across cells. Make physical objects immediately recognizable with a handful of bold shapes. No cheerful cartoon styling, decorative fantasy equipment or fine technical illustration.
referenceRoles: Style only: approved white silhouette glyphs, no subject transfer
